```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
base_path <- paste0("C:/Users/bruna/Desktop/GitHub/coupled-esns/data/v3/matched_budget/ensemble_")
```

```{r, message=F}
sweep_full <- data.frame("esize"=c(), "rsize"=c(), "plink"=c(), "tsigma"=c(), "rconn"=c(), "acc"=c(), "se"=c())

for(i in c("1","2","4","8","16")){
  batch_1 <- read_csv(paste0(base_path, i, "/psweep_same_batch_1.csv"))
  batch_2 <- read_csv(paste0(base_path, i, "/psweep_same_batch_2.csv"))
  batch_3 <- read_csv(paste0(base_path, i, "/psweep_same_batch_3.csv")) 
  
  sweep <- rbind(batch_1, batch_2, batch_3) %>%
    select(!c(sim, batch))
  
  sweep_full <- rbind(sweep_full, sweep)
}
```

```{r}
sweep_cleaned <- sweep_full %>%
  mutate(budget = factor(esize * rsize,
                         levels = c("400", "800", "1600"), labels = c("low", "mid", "high")),
         esize = factor(esize))

ggplot(sweep_cleaned, aes(x=budget, y=acc, group=esize, color=esize, fill=esize)) +
  facet_wrap(~tsigma) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = acc - se, ymax = acc + se), alpha = 0.2, linetype = 0) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(sweep_cleaned, aes(x=budget, y=acc, fill=esize)) +
  facet_wrap(~tsigma) +
  geom_bar(position="dodge", stat="identity") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=acc-se, ymax=acc+se), position="dodge") +
  scale_fill_discrete_sequential() +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(sweep_cleaned %>% filter(rsize %in% c(100,200)),
       aes(x=esize, y=acc, group=factor(rsize), color=factor(rsize), fill=factor(rsize))) +
  facet_wrap(~tsigma) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=acc-se, ymax=acc+se), alpha=0.2, linetype=0) +
  theme_minimal()
```
